steps.prompt:

steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sale_items WHERE unit_price BETWEEN 95.34 AND 99.7;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sale_items.
Add WHERE unit_price BETWEEN …
Write the two ends with AND between them.
